name: Mercy (Rahma)

definition_by_age.4: Being gentle with someone who made a mistake.
definition_by_age.6: Rahma means being gentle and caring, especially to those who are struggling.
definition_by_age.8: Rahma is mercy and compassion, a quality of Allah that we're asked to show to others too.

learning_objective: Children can describe showing gentleness to someone who was upset.

recommended_default.note: Retrieval ranking (retrieval_ranking.md) starts from this combination and diversity-penalizes away from it on repeat use, per recommended_story_combinations.md.

hd_003.reasoning: Directly and explicitly about mercy to the young.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Helping an elderly neighbor fits responsibility/follow-through.
Standing up for a smaller child fits conversation/reconciliation.
